subject.title: fix(providers): honor proxies in model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw approve this PR’s explicit roster of canonical provider catalog origins as eligible to send authenticated discovery traffic through an operator-configured environment proxy?
rationale: This is an intentional trust-boundary policy choice: tests can prove the selected behavior, but they cannot determine which vendor-owned endpoints are acceptable proxy targets for the product.

options.title: Approve the scoped roster and refresh proof
options.body: Resolve the merge conflict and add exact-head transport evidence for the final canonical-origin roster, including the Bedrock configured-endpoint exception.

options.title: Narrow the roster first
options.body: Limit trusted-proxy routing to the providers and origins explicitly needed for the reported regressions, leaving other catalogs strict until separately reviewed.

options.title: Pause the consolidation
options.body: Keep the narrower related fixes independent if maintainers do not want one shared policy change to govern this many providers.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped roster and refresh proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the merge conflict and add exact-head transport evidence for the final canonical-origin roster, including the Bedrock configured-endpoint exception.
